title: Bellingham in Athens v Zidane, Gerrard and Lampard at the same age
checked: AEK Athens v Real Madrid, Champions League league phase, 4 Nov 2026 (Bundesliga.com fixture page + Squawka). Bellingham born 29 Jun 2003 = 23y 128d that day. League record to 1 Nov 2026: Birmingham 41/4, Dortmund 92/12, Real Madrid 98/38 = 231 games, 54 goals (Wikipedia; the seasons to 2024-25 match the well-known totals, including 19 La Liga goals in 2023-24). First Clásico, 28 Oct 2023 at Montjuïc: Gündoğan 6, Bellingham 68 from about 30 yards into the top corner, Bellingham's winner in stoppage time, Barça 1-2 Real (FourFourTwo + Football España + The National). 2023-24 La Liga and Champions League (final 1 Jun 2024 v Dortmund, 2-0) at 20 (Wikipedia + well known). Same age: Zidane 29 Oct 1995 = 28 league goals in 167 games before 1995-96 (Cannes + Bordeaux, Wikipedia); Gerrard 5 Oct 2003 = 16 in 136 before 2003-04 (StatMuse + Wikipedia); Lampard 26 Oct 2001 = 24 in 148 before 2001-02, his first months at Chelsea (Premier League Hall of Fame + Wikipedia). These three fall early in a season, so they show a plus. Goals by age = cumulative league goals after the season that ended the summer each turned that age, from the same tables. First Champions League wins: Zidane 15 May 2002 (29), Gerrard 25 May 2005 (24, five days short of 25), Lampard 19 May 2012 (33), Bellingham 1 Jun 2024 (20); ages by arithmetic from birth dates. Goals per 100 games = simple division. The Clásico equaliser is recreated as a long-range goal; the assist is not sourced, so the pop-up shows none.

lines.text: In Athens on the fourth of November, Jude Bellingham is twenty-three years and one hundred and twenty-eight days old.
lines.say: In Athens, on the fourth of November, Jude Bellingum is twenty three years, and one hundred and twenty eight days old.

lines.text: He was twenty when he played his first Clásico. One-nil down at Montjuïc, he did this from thirty yards.
lines.say: He was twenty, when he played his first Clasico. One nil down at Moonjooeek, he did this, from thirty yards.

lines.text: Then, in stoppage time, the winner. Two goals in his first Clásico.
lines.say: Then, in stoppage time, the winner. Two goals, in his first Clasico.

lines.text: That season: nineteen league goals, La Liga, and the Champions League. He was still twenty.
lines.say: That season: nineteen league goals, La Liga, and the Champions League. He was still twenty.

lines.text: Today, he has fifty-four league goals in two hundred and thirty-one games.
lines.say: Today, he has fifty four league goals, in two hundred and thirty one games.

lines.text: So line him up with the great goal-scoring midfielders, at exactly the same age.
Zinedine Zidane, October ninety-five, at Bordeaux: twenty-eight league goals.
lines.say: Zeenedeen Zeedan, October ninety five, at Bordoh: twenty eight league goals.

lines.text: Steven Gerrard, October two thousand and three: sixteen. Frank Lampard, just signed by Chelsea: twenty-four.
lines.say: Steven Jerrard, October, two thousand and three: sixteen. Frank Lampard, just signed by Chelsea: twenty four.

lines.text: Put them on a graph by age, and Bellingham pulls away the moment he reaches Madrid.
lines.say: Put them on a graph by age, and Bellingum pulls away, the moment he reaches Madrid.

lines.text: Fifty-four. Nearly double Zidane. More than three times Gerrard.
lines.say: Fifty four. Nearly double Zeedan. More than three times Jerrard.

lines.text: He's played more games, so match them. Per hundred league games, he still wins.
lines.say: He's played more games, so match them. Per hundred league games, he still wins.

lines.text: And the big one. Gerrard waited for Istanbul at twenty-four. Zidane, twenty-nine. Lampard, thirty-three.
lines.say: And the big one. Jerrard waited for Istanbul, at twenty four. Zeedan, twenty nine. Lampard, thirty three.

scene.kicker: Age at first Champions League win
scene.title: The big one

lines.text: So at this age, Bellingham is ahead of all three. On goals, on rate, and on the biggest trophy.
lines.say: So at this age, Bellingum is ahead of all three. On goals, on rate, and on the biggest trophy.

lines.text: But can he finish like Zidane did? Tell me in the comments.
lines.say: But can he finish like Zeedan did? Tell me in the comments.

lines.text: Follow for more, and play Road to Ballon d'Or.
